statement_summary: One group program aligned to CSF 2.0 meeting the Safeguards Rule for Home Loans and Title
Group CISO is Qualified Individual; institution presidents oversee with quarterly minutes
Annual SP 800-30 risk assessment per division with roll-up to group
Risk acceptance authority by level; High customer-funds risks treated
Every division keeps a supplement; re-align within 90 days; annual attestation
Divisions document common control inheritance yearly
Sanctions for workforce and contractor agents
Written safeguards for every service provider, including the parent for Home Loans and Title; yearly reassessment of tier 1
Out-of-band payee verification for every payment change in every division; dual approval; portal-only instructions
Internal audit assesses common controls yearly and samples divisions
Qualified Individual reports in writing at least yearly to both institution boards
Exceptions in writing, risk-rated, 12 months maximum; expired exceptions end access
Program records kept 6 years
AI systems registered and approved under the Group AI Standard
Unique identity for every employee and contractor agent
Least privilege; transaction-team visibility in SYS-B1
MFA for every individual including contractor agents; hardware keys for admins and wire roles
Service accounts owned, governed, workload identity, 90-day rotation
Employee removal within 4 hours; contractor agents within 1 business day; 60-day inactivity
Quarterly access certification
Privileged access just in time through PAM
Lockout and session limits
Sign-in risk analytics for every identity tier
Vendor access only through group PAM
Consumer identity proofing before instructions; borrower MFA; smart-home roles removed at closing
Personal devices only through approved apps with app protection
Report suspected incidents and suspicious payment requests within 1 hour
One group severity scale and playbooks
Discovery date recorded per institution and per state clock
FTC notice per institution when 500 or more of its consumers are affected
Counsel maintains the multi-regulator matrix, including insurance law states
Disclosure committee within 24 hours; Form 8-K Item 1.05 within 4 business days of materiality
Immediate recall request and IC3 complaint; loan-related fraud to the BSA officer
Ransom payment approvals and OFAC check
Yearly cross-division exercise with the matrix and a materiality decision
Lessons learned within 30 days
Four classes; Restricted includes customer information, consumer reports, and wire instructions
Encryption at rest and in transit; compensating controls approved by the Qualified Individual
Wire instructions only through the portal; never by email or text
Affiliate sharing only for registered purposes with consent basis and referral disclosure
Tags and separate zones for Safeguards Rule customer information on shared platforms
Immutable, separated, restore-tested backups
Disposal no later than two years after last use unless needed or required; yearly schedule review
Annual training for workforce and agents; agents lose access 30 days after missing it
Role-based payee verification training before access
No sending, forwarding, or changing payment instructions by email or text
Restricted information only on managed devices or protected apps
Approved generative AI tools only
Fair housing check on all advertising, including AI drafts
